description: Source code implementing DSA ASN.1 encoding/decoding and related cryptographic operations for OpenSSL.

classes.name: dsa_asn1_meth
classes.description: Structure defining ASN.1 methods for DSA key handling.

methods.name: dsa_pub_decode
methods.description: Decodes DSA public key from ASN.1 format into EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: dsa_pub_encode
methods.description: Encodes DSA public key from EVP_PKEY into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: dsa_priv_decode
methods.description: Decodes DSA private key from ASN.1 format into EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: dsa_priv_encode
methods.description: Encodes DSA private key from EVP_PKEY into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: dsa_bits
methods.description: Returns number of bits in DSA prime.

methods.name: dsa_missing_parameters
methods.description: Checks if DSA parameters are missing.

methods.name: dup_bn_into
methods.description: Duplicates a BIGNUM into another pointer.

methods.name: dsa_copy_parameters
methods.description: Copies DSA parameters from one EVP_PKEY to another.

methods.name: dsa_cmp_parameters
methods.description: Compares DSA parameters between two EVP_PKEYs.
